queries: How do I fix a washer that does not turn on?
My Samsung washer won't turn on.
The washer cannot turn on properly.

expected_steps.instruction: Make sure the washer is not currently in a power interruption. Check whether lights or another appliance on the same electrical circuit are working.
Go to the washer's power cord and confirm that the plug is fully inserted into the electrical outlet. Do not rely only on looking at the plug; make sure it has not become partially disconnected.
Inspect the plug and the visible portion of the power cord without touching exposed conductors. Look for cuts, melted areas, discoloration, loose parts, or signs of overheating.
If the cord and plug appear normal, press the Power button once. Wait a few seconds and observe the control panel for any lights or display activity.
If there is still no response, check the electrical outlet using a safe method. If you are not comfortable testing an outlet, have a qualified person verify that the outlet is supplying power.
If the outlet has no power, do not attempt to repair the household wiring yourself. Restore the household electrical supply or contact a qualified electrician.
If the outlet has power, disconnect the washer from the outlet before doing any further external inspection. Wait briefly, reconnect it securely, and press Power again.

If the washer remains completely unresponsive even though the outlet has power, stop the procedure. The problem may be inside the washer's power/control system and should be diagnosed by service personnel.

safety_requirements: Do not bypass a fuse, circuit breaker, grounding connection, or other protective device.

queries: How do I fix a washer that does not start?
My Samsung washer won't start.
The washer cannot start properly.

expected_steps.instruction: Press Power and confirm that the control panel turns on normally.
Make sure the washer door/lid is fully closed. Open it and close it again firmly so the machine can detect the closed position.
Check both water-source faucets. Make sure they are open so the washer can obtain the water required to begin the cycle.
Check that the water inlet hoses are connected and are not obviously kinked or crushed.
Select the required wash cycle and any desired options.
Press the Start/Pause button deliberately once. Do not assume that selecting a cycle alone starts the washer.

After pressing Start/Pause, wait briefly. The washer may make clicking sounds before filling because it checks the door lock and performs a quick drain. This is described in the model's troubleshooting guidance and is not by itself evidence of a failure.
If the washer still does not start, check whether Child Lock is active. If the Child Lock indicator is present, follow the Child Lock procedure in Topic 5.
If the display shows an information/error code, record the exact code before attempting additional troubleshooting.
If all external checks are normal and the washer still refuses to start, stop the procedure and arrange service rather than opening the machine.

queries: How do I fix Start/Pause button not responding on my Samsung washer?
My Samsung washer has a problem: Start/Pause button not responding.
Troubleshooting guide for Start/Pause button not responding on washer.

expected_steps.instruction: Look at the control panel and confirm that the washer is powered on.
Check the Child Lock indicator. If Child Lock is active, the other buttons are locked and pressing them may cause the Child Lock indicator to blink.
If Child Lock is active, press and hold the Spin and Soil Level buttons simultaneously for approximately 3 seconds.
Wait for the Child Lock indicator to turn off. Then press Start/Pause once and observe whether the washer responds.
If Child Lock was not active, make sure the control panel is dry and clean. Do not press buttons with wet hands or while liquid is present on the panel.
Confirm that you have selected a valid wash cycle before pressing Start/Pause.
Press Start/Pause once and wait. Avoid repeatedly pressing the button because repeated inputs can make it harder to determine whether the washer has accepted the command.
If the washer still does not respond to Start/Pause, check whether another information/error code is displayed.
If the Power button works but Start/Pause consistently does not respond after these checks, the control interface or another control component may require service diagnosis.

queries: How do I troubleshoot a washer that stops immediately after starting?

What should I do when the washer stops immediately after starting?

expected_steps.instruction: Observe the display immediately after the washer stops. If an information/error code appears, write it down exactly.

Press Start/Pause again and observe whether the washer begins operation.
Check that both water-source faucets are open.
Look at the inlet hoses and make sure they are connected and not sharply kinked or crushed.
Check whether Child Lock is active. If it is, deactivate it using the procedure in Topic 5.

queries: How do I disable or resolve Child Lock preventing operation on my Samsung washer?
Samsung washer controls locked: Child Lock preventing operation.
Troubleshoot Child Lock preventing operation on Samsung washer.

expected_steps.instruction: Look at the control panel and identify whether the Child Lock indicator is illuminated.
Press a button other than Power once. If the buttons are locked, the Child Lock indicator may blink instead of allowing the command.
To deactivate Child Lock, press and hold the Spin and Soil Level buttons simultaneously.
Continue holding both buttons for approximately 3 seconds.
Release both buttons and check the control panel. The Child Lock indicator should no longer indicate that the controls are locked.
Press Start/Pause once to check whether normal operation has returned.
If the Child Lock function was intentionally enabled for safety, do not deactivate it until you are ready to operate the washer.
Remember that the Child Lock setting can remain active even after the washer is powered off and back on.
If the controls remain locked even after the specified button combination is performed correctly, record the behavior and arrange service.

queries: How do I fix a Samsung washer that trips the circuit breaker or fuse?
My Samsung washer keeps tripping the breaker when running.

expected_steps.instruction: Stop using the washer immediately if the breaker trips or the fuse opens.
Do not repeatedly reset the breaker or replace the fuse while the washer remains connected if the protective device continues to trip.
Disconnect the washer from the electrical outlet if this can be done safely and there is no sign of burning, arcing, or physical damage.
Look only at the accessible plug, cord, and outlet. Check for visible melting, discoloration, smoke residue, or a burning smell.

If there is no visible damage and the household circuit is otherwise normal, have the circuit and outlet checked by a qualified electrician before returning the washer to service.
Do not substitute a fuse with one of a different rating and do not bypass the circuit breaker.
If a qualified person confirms the outlet/circuit is suitable but the washer continues to trip the protection device, the washer requires service diagnosis.
Do not open the control panel or attempt internal electrical measurements unless you are a qualified service professional using the appropriate service procedure.

safety_requirements: Electrical protection devices exist to prevent hazardous conditions. Never bypass or defeat them.

Troubleshooting steps for washer turns off unexpectedly.

How do I fix a washer that does not drain?
My Samsung washer won't drain.

expected_steps.instruction: Stop the cycle and switch the washer off. If water remains in the tub, do not force the washer into another cycle.
Inspect the visible drain hose from the washer to the household drain. Look for sharp bends, crushing, kinks, blockage, or a hose that has become displaced.
Check the drain outlet and household standpipe/drain point for obvious blockage. Make sure the hose is positioned according to the installation requirements.
If the hose is kinked, straighten it without sharply bending it. If a visible external obstruction is present, remove it only when it can be done safely.
Restart the washer and select an appropriate drain/spin operation. Observe whether the water level falls and whether the drain flow is continuous.
If the washer hums but water does not leave, or if draining repeatedly stops, do not dismantle the drain pump unless you are a qualified service technician.
If the problem persists, service diagnosis may be required for the drain pump, wiring, control system, or an internal obstruction.
